Originally, Tylecodon was a part of the genus Cotyledon. Dr. Helmut Toelken of the South Australian Herbarium split them off into a genus of their own, the name is an anagram of the earlier name. https://worldofsucculents.com/genera/tylecodon/
From New Latin tylarus, from Ancient Greek τυλάριον (tulárion, “cushion”).
From Latin tylo-, from Ancient Greek τύλη (túlē, “swelling”) and τύλος (túlos, “lump, knot”).
From Latin tylo-, from Ancient Greek τύλη (túlē, “swelling”) and τύλος (túlos, “lump, knot”). By surface analysis, tyl- + -o-.
